movies.cast: George Reeves, Phyllis Coates, Jeff Corey
movies.plot: Superman must protect a pair of small, harmless alien beings unearthed by an oil-drilling operation from a fearful, torch-wielding mob.
movies.blurb: George Reeves' first outing as Superman — the first-ever feature film based on a DC character, and the pilot for Adventures of Superman.

movies.cast: Christopher Reeve, Margot Kidder, Gene Hackman, Marlon Brando
movies.plot: Sent to Earth as an infant from the dying planet Krypton, Kal-El grows up as Clark Kent and becomes the costumed hero Superman, facing his first great test against the criminal mastermind Lex Luthor.
movies.blurb: Christopher Reeve's origin-to-icon debut; the film that proved a superhero movie could be prestige cinema.

movies.cast: Christopher Reeve, Margot Kidder, Terence Stamp, Gene Hackman
movies.plot: Three escaped Kryptonian criminals led by General Zod arrive on Earth demanding submission, forcing Superman to weigh giving up his powers for a life with Lois against defending the planet.
movies.blurb: Zod and the Phantom Zone criminals arrive; Superman gives up his powers for Lois, then takes them back.

movies.cast: Christopher Reeve, Richard Pryor, Margot Kidder, Annette O'Toole
movies.plot: A computer-programming con man's synthetic kryptonite splits Superman into a good and an evil version of himself, while a corrupt businessman schemes to corner the world's oil market.
movies.blurb: A tonal swing toward comedy, pitting Superman against a corrupted version of himself and Richard Pryor's hacker.

movies.cast: Helen Slater, Faye Dunaway, Peter O'Toole, Mia Farrow
movies.plot: Kara Zor-El leaves the Kryptonian survivor colony of Argo City to retrieve a lost artifact on Earth, where she must stop an ambitious witch from harnessing its power.
movies.blurb: Kara's solo spin-off from the Superman film series, poorly received on release.

movies.cast: Christopher Reeve, Gene Hackman, Margot Kidder, Jon Cryer
movies.plot: Superman takes it upon himself to rid the world of nuclear weapons, only for Lex Luthor to create a powerful solar-charged adversary called Nuclear Man to stop him.
movies.t: Superman IV: The Quest for Peace
movies.blurb: A famously troubled production sees Superman take on nuclear disarmament and Nuclear Man.

movies.cast: Brandon Routh, Kate Bosworth, Kevin Spacey, James Marsden
movies.plot: Superman returns to Earth after a years-long absence to find Lois Lane engaged to another man and Lex Luthor plotting a real-estate scheme powered by stolen Kryptonian crystal technology.
movies.blurb: Bryan Singer's spiritual sequel to Superman II, ignoring III and IV, with Brandon Routh as Clark.

movies.cast: Louis Jourdan, Adrienne Barbeau, Ray Wise
movies.plot: A scientist transformed into a plant-based creature by his own experiment must protect a government agent and a stolen bio-restorative formula from a power-hungry rival.
movies.blurb: Wes Craven's B-movie take on the muck-monster hero, based on the Len Wein/Bernie Wrightson comic.

movies.cast: Louis Jourdan, Heather Locklear, Sarah Douglas
movies.plot: A campier sequel finding Swamp Thing protecting the stepdaughter of his old nemesis from being used in further monstrous experiments.
movies.blurb: A campier sequel leaning further into B-movie horror-comedy.

movies.cast: Michael Keaton, Jack Nicholson, Kim Basinger, Robert Wuhl
movies.plot: Billionaire Bruce Wayne's masked alter-ego faces off against the Joker, a disfigured gangster who terrorizes Gotham City with a garish, murderous sense of showmanship.
movies.blurb: Tim Burton's gothic, operatic take on Gotham, with Jack Nicholson's Joker.

movies.cast: Michael Keaton, Danny DeVito, Michelle Pfeiffer, Christopher Walken
movies.plot: Batman contends with the grotesque Penguin's mayoral ambitions and a vengeful Catwoman, both manipulated by a corrupt businessman with his own designs on Gotham.
movies.blurb: Burton doubles down on the grotesque with Catwoman and Penguin as tragic monsters.

movies.cast: Val Kilmer, Tommy Lee Jones, Jim Carrey, Nicole Kidman, Chris O'Donnell
movies.plot: Batman contends with the dual threat of Two-Face and the Riddler while taking in a new ward, Dick Grayson, who becomes his first cinematic Robin.
movies.blurb: Joel Schumacher brightens the tone considerably; Two-Face and the Riddler headline.

movies.cast: George Clooney, Arnold Schwarzenegger, Chris O'Donnell, Uma Thurman, Alicia Silverstone
movies.plot: Batman and Robin, joined by Barbara Wilson as Batgirl, face the icy Mr. Freeze and the seductive Poison Ivy in Gotham's campiest, most colorful chapter.
movies.blurb: Neon camp excess that effectively ended the franchise until Nolan's reboot.

movies.cast: Shaquille O'Neal, Annabeth Gish, Judd Nelson, Richard Roundtree
movies.plot: A military weapons designer builds a suit of armor to become the vigilante Steel after a rogue former colleague sells his illegal weapons designs to criminals on the street.
movies.blurb: Shaquille O'Neal stars as John Henry Irons, loosely based on the post-Death of Superman hero.

movies.cast: Halle Berry, Benjamin Bratt, Sharon Stone, Lambert Wilson
movies.plot: A meek graphic designer is murdered after discovering her cosmetics company's dangerous secret, then resurrected with feline powers and a new identity as the vigilante Catwoman.
movies.blurb: Halle Berry stars in a version of Catwoman not directly tied to the comics character.

movies.cast: Keanu Reeves, Rachel Weisz, Shia LaBeouf, Tilda Swinton
movies.plot: A cynical occult detective who can see angels and demons investigates a supernatural conspiracy behind a police detective's sister's suicide, uncovering a scheme to bring Hell to Earth.
movies.blurb: Keanu Reeves as a chain-smoking occult detective, loosely based on Hellblazer.

movies.cast: Christian Bale, Michael Caine, Liam Neeson, Katie Holmes, Gary Oldman, Cillian Murphy
movies.plot: After training with the mysterious League of Shadows, Bruce Wayne returns to a crime-ridden Gotham to become Batman, confronting the corrupt underworld and a plot by his former mentor to destroy the city.
movies.blurb: Christopher Nolan grounds Batman's origin in realism; the start of The Dark Knight Trilogy.

movies.cast: Christian Bale, Heath Ledger, Aaron Eckhart, Michael Caine, Maggie Gyllenhaal, Gary Oldman
movies.plot: With Gotham's underworld in disarray, the Joker emerges as a force of pure chaos, pushing Batman, Jim Gordon, and DA Harvey Dent to their moral limits as they try to save a city that may not deserve saving.
movies.blurb: Heath Ledger's Joker anchors a crime-thriller take on Batman vs. chaos.

movies.cast: Christian Bale, Tom Hardy, Anne Hathaway, Joseph Gordon-Levitt, Marion Cotillard
movies.plot: Eight years after taking the blame for Harvey Dent's crimes, a broken Bruce Wayne returns as Batman to face Bane, a masked mercenary threatening to level Gotham City.
movies.blurb: Bane and Talia al Ghul close out the trilogy with Gotham under siege.

movies.cast: Jackie Earle Haley, Patrick Wilson, Malin Åkerman, Billy Crudup, Matthew Goode, Jeffrey Dean Morgan
movies.plot: In an alternate 1985 where masked vigilantes are outlawed, the murder of a government-sponsored former hero draws his estranged colleagues out of retirement and into a conspiracy tied to the looming threat of nuclear war.
movies.blurb: Zack Snyder's dense adaptation of Alan Moore and Dave Gibbons' deconstruction of superheroes.

movies.cast: Hugo Weaving, Natalie Portman, Stephen Rea, Stephen Fry
movies.plot: In a dystopian, fascist near-future Britain, a masked anarchist known as V wages a personal war of terrorism and inspiration against the totalitarian government, drawing a young woman into his crusade.
movies.blurb: Alan Moore and David Lloyd's dystopian anarchist tale, adapted by the Wachowskis (as writers/producers).

movies.cast: Charlie Cox, Claire Danes, Michelle Pfeiffer, Robert De Niro
movies.plot: A young man ventures into a magical kingdom to retrieve a fallen star for the woman he loves, discovering the star is a living being pursued by witches and princes alike, based on Neil Gaiman's Vertigo miniseries.
movies.blurb: A fantasy romance based on Neil Gaiman and Charles Vess' Vertigo miniseries.

movies.cast: Jeffrey Dean Morgan, Zoe Saldana, Chris Evans, Idris Elba
movies.plot: A black-ops team framed for a crime they didn't commit goes rogue to take down the CIA operative who betrayed them, based on the Vertigo series.
movies.blurb: A black-ops team framed for a crime they didn't commit, based on the Vertigo series.

movies.cast: Josh Brolin, Megan Fox, John Malkovich
movies.plot: A scarred, supernaturally-touched bounty hunter is recruited by the U.S. government to stop a Confederate general from unleashing a devastating superweapon.
movies.blurb: A poorly-received Western adaptation of DC's scarred bounty-hunter antihero.

movies.cast: Bruce Willis, Morgan Freeman, John Malkovich, Helen Mirren
movies.plot: A retired black-ops agent reassembles his old team of equally 'Retired, Extremely Dangerous' operatives after becoming the target of a assassination plot.
movies.blurb: Retired black-ops agents are targeted for elimination, based on Warren Ellis and Cully Hamner's WildStorm miniseries.

movies.cast: Bruce Willis, John Malkovich, Mary-Louise Parker, Helen Mirren, Catherine Zeta-Jones
movies.plot: The retired team reunites for a globe-trotting mission to track down a portable nuclear device before it falls into the wrong hands.
movies.blurb: The sequel to Red, sending the retired team on a globe-trotting mission.

movies.cast: Melissa McCarthy, Tiffany Haddish, Elisabeth Moss
movies.plot: Three mob wives take over their imprisoned husbands' Hell's Kitchen rackets in 1978, becoming more ruthless than the men they replaced, based on the DC Vertigo miniseries.
movies.blurb: Three mob wives take over their husbands' Hell's Kitchen rackets, based on the DC Vertigo miniseries.

movies.cast: Tom Hanks, Paul Newman, Jude Law, Daniel Craig
movies.plot: A Depression-era Irish mob enforcer goes on the run with his young son after a betrayal costs him his family, seeking revenge against the men responsible.
movies.blurb: A Depression-era mob drama based on Max Allan Collins' graphic novel, published under DC's Paradox Press imprint.

movies.cast: Viggo Mortensen, Maria Bello, Ed Harris, William Hurt
movies.plot: A small-town diner owner's act of self-defense against armed robbers thrusts him into the spotlight, drawing the attention of mobsters who claim to recognize him from a violent past.
movies.blurb: A diner owner's violent past resurfaces, based on the graphic novel published by DC/Vertigo.

movies.cast: Sean Connery, Naseeruddin Shah, Peta Wilson, Stuart Townsend
movies.plot: A team of Victorian literary icons — including Allan Quatermain, Captain Nemo, and the Invisible Man — assembles to stop a mysterious mastermind from igniting a world war.
movies.blurb: Victorian literary icons team up, based on Alan Moore and Kevin O'Neill's WildStorm series.

movies.cast: Ryan Reynolds, Blake Lively, Peter Sarsgaard, Mark Strong
movies.plot: Test pilot Hal Jordan becomes the first human Green Lantern, gaining a power ring from a dying alien and joining an intergalactic police force to defend Earth from the fear-fueled entity Parallax.
movies.blurb: Ryan Reynolds' first superhero outing, a critical and commercial disappointment for the character's live-action debut.

movies.cast: Henry Cavill, Amy Adams, Michael Shannon, Russell Crowe, Kevin Costner, Diane Lane
movies.plot: Clark Kent, unsure of whether the world is ready for a superpowered alien among them, must decide whether to reveal himself as Superman when General Zod and the Kryptonian remnant threaten Earth in search of the Codex Clark's father hid before Krypton's destruction.
movies.blurb: Zack Snyder relaunches Superman as a darker, mythic figure; opens the DC Extended Universe.

movies.cast: Ben Affleck, Henry Cavill, Amy Adams, Jesse Eisenberg, Gal Gadot, Diane Lane
movies.plot: Fearing Superman's power is unchecked and dangerous, Batman goes to war against him while the world debates the hero's place in it — until Lex Luthor manipulates both into becoming pawns of a greater threat.
movies.t: Batman v Superman: Dawn of Justice
movies.blurb: Introduces Ben Affleck's Batman and sets up the Justice League; also the first live-action Wonder Woman.

movies.cast: Will Smith, Jared Leto, Margot Robbie, Joel Kinnaman, Viola Davis
movies.plot: A secret government agency recruits imprisoned supervillains for dangerous black-ops missions in exchange for reduced sentences, deploying them against a mystical threat that emerges in Midway City.
movies.blurb: A team of imprisoned villains is sent on a black-ops mission.

movies.cast: Gal Gadot, Chris Pine, Robin Wright, Danny Huston, David Thewlis, Connie Nielsen
movies.plot: Diana, an Amazon princess raised on the hidden island of Themyscira, leaves her home to fight in World War I after rescuing an American pilot, discovering the full extent of her powers and heritage along the way.
movies.blurb: Diana's WWI-set origin, widely seen as a turning point for the DCEU's critical reception.

movies.cast: Ben Affleck, Henry Cavill, Gal Gadot, Ezra Miller, Jason Momoa, Ray Fisher
movies.plot: Following Superman's death, Batman and Wonder Woman recruit Flash, Aquaman, and Cyborg to stand against the newly awakened threat of Steppenwolf and his army of Parademons.
movies.blurb: The theatrical cut, finished by Joss Whedon after Snyder departed production.

movies.cast: Ben Affleck, Henry Cavill, Gal Gadot, Ezra Miller, Jason Momoa, Ray Fisher
movies.plot: Zack Snyder's original vision for the team-up, restoring cut material and reshaping the story into a four-part, four-hour cut released directly to streaming rather than theaters.
movies.boxOffice: HBO Max exclusive release — no theatrical run
movies.blurb: The four-hour director's cut released after years of fan campaigning; a substantially different film from 2017's.

movies.cast: Jason Momoa, Amber Heard, Willem Dafoe, Patrick Wilson, Nicole Kidman
movies.plot: Half-human, half-Atlantean Arthur Curry must reluctantly embrace his birthright and unite the underwater kingdoms to stop his power-hungry half-brother Orm from waging war on the surface world.
movies.blurb: Arthur Curry claims the throne of Atlantis in a colorful, undersea epic.

movies.cast: Zachary Levi, Asher Angel, Mark Strong, Jack Dylan Grazer
movies.plot: Foster kid Billy Batson can transform into the adult superhero Shazam by saying a wizard's name, and must learn to use his powers responsibly while facing the monstrous Seven Deadly Sins.
movies.blurb: A foster kid who transforms into an adult hero, played with family-comedy warmth.

movies.cast: Margot Robbie, Mary Elizabeth Winstead, Jurnee Smollett, Ewan McGregor
movies.plot: After splitting from the Joker, Harley Quinn joins forces with Black Canary, Huntress, and Renee Montoya to protect a young pickpocket from the sadistic crime lord Roman Sionis.
movies.blurb: Harley Quinn, freshly split from the Joker, teams up with Gotham's other women.

movies.cast: Gal Gadot, Chris Pine, Kristen Wiig, Pedro Pascal
movies.plot: Decades after WWI, Diana Prince must contend with a wish-granting ancient artifact that resurrects Steve Trevor and empowers a new, dangerously ambitious foe: the Cheetah.
movies.blurb: Diana faces a wish-granting artifact in the excess of the Reagan era.

movies.cast: Margot Robbie, Idris Elba, John Cena, Joel Kinnaman, Sylvester Stallone (voice), Viola Davis
movies.plot: A new, mostly-expendable lineup of imprisoned supervillains is sent to the island nation of Corto Maltese to destroy a secret Nazi-era research facility before a project called Starro is unleashed.
movies.blurb: James Gunn's R-rated, mostly standalone reboot of the concept.

movies.cast: Dwayne Johnson, Aldis Hodge, Noah Centineo, Sarah Shahi, Pierce Brosnan
movies.plot: Nearly 5,000 years after being bestowed with the almighty powers of the Egyptian gods, Teth-Adam is freed from his earthly tomb, ready to unleash his unique form of justice on the modern world.
movies.blurb: Dwayne Johnson's antihero is freed from millennia of imprisonment.

movies.cast: Zachary Levi, Asher Angel, Helen Mirren, Lucy Liu
movies.plot: The now-teenage Shazamily faces the vengeful Daughters of Atlas, who seek to reclaim the magic stolen from the gods and threaten to unravel the world.
movies.blurb: The Shazam family faces the daughters of Atlas.

movies.cast: Ezra Miller, Michael Keaton, Sasha Calle, Michael Shannon
movies.plot: Barry Allen uses his speed to travel back in time to prevent his mother's murder, inadvertently fracturing the timeline and colliding with alternate versions of Batman and a doomed Krypton.
movies.blurb: Barry Allen's time-travel misadventure, and the effective finale of the Snyderverse continuity.

movies.cast: Xolo Maridueña, Bruna Marquezine, George Lopez, Susan Sarandon
movies.plot: Recent college grad Jaime Reyes becomes bonded to an ancient alien scarab that grants him a powerful suit of armor, forcing him to protect his family from a ruthless tech CEO.
movies.blurb: Jaime Reyes bonds with an alien scarab; the last new DCEU hero introduced.

movies.cast: Jason Momoa, Patrick Wilson, Yahya Abdul-Mateen II, Amber Heard
movies.plot: Arthur Curry must team with his imprisoned brother Orm to stop Black Manta, who wields the power of the mythic Black Trident and threatens to unleash an ancient, world-ending force.
movies.blurb: The final film released under the original DCEU banner.

movies.cast: Joaquin Phoenix, Robert De Niro, Zazie Beetz, Frances Conroy
movies.plot: Failed comedian Arthur Fleck, ground down by a city that has abandoned its most vulnerable, undergoes a breakdown that leads him to embrace violence and become an icon of chaos in a decaying Gotham.
movies.blurb: A grounded character study of Arthur Fleck's descent, disconnected from any shared DC continuity.

movies.cast: Joaquin Phoenix, Lady Gaga, Brendan Gleeson, Catherine Keener
movies.plot: Awaiting trial in Arkham State Hospital, Arthur Fleck falls for fellow patient Lee Quinzel as the two channel their shared bond into an increasingly public, musical descent.
movies.blurb: A musical-tinged sequel following Arthur's trial and his bond with Harley Quinn.

movies.cast: Robert Pattinson, Zoë Kravitz, Paul Dano, Jeffrey Wright, Colin Farrell, John Turturro
movies.plot: In his second year fighting crime, a reclusive, obsessive Batman uncovers corruption in Gotham's political and criminal elite while hunting the Riddler, a serial killer targeting the city's most powerful figures.
movies.blurb: Matt Reeves' noir detective-thriller take, standalone from the DCEU and DCU.

movies.cast: David Corenswet, Rachel Brosnahan, Nicholas Hoult, Edi Gathegi, Anthony Carrigan
movies.plot: James Gunn's relaunch follows an earlier-in-career Superman balancing his Kryptonian heritage and human upbringing while Lex Luthor manipulates public opinion against him, opening the new shared DC Universe.
movies.blurb: James Gunn's relaunch of the character, opening the new shared DC Universe (DCU).

movies.cast: Milly Alcock, Matthias Schoenaerts, Eve Ridley, David Krumholtz, Emily Beecham, Jason Momoa
movies.plot: Kara Zor-El, still finding her footing as a hero on Earth, reluctantly teams with a scarred outsider for an interstellar journey of vengeance and justice after a brutal attack strikes close to home.
movies.blurb: Milly Alcock's Kara Zor-El, the second live-action film of the new DCU.

movies.plot: A body-horror take on the shapeshifting Batman villain, following a struggling actor whose desperate use of an experimental cosmetic compound transforms him into the monstrous Clayface. Set in the new DCU; still upcoming, with most casting and plot details unconfirmed at time of writing.
movies.blurb: A body-horror take on the shapeshifting Batman villain, set in the new DCU.

movies.plot: The direct sequel to 2025's Superman, continuing the DCU's Chapter 1 slate. Still upcoming, with cast and plot details largely unconfirmed at time of writing.
movies.blurb: The Superman sequel, continuing the DCU's Chapter 1 slate.

movies.cast: Robert Pattinson, Zoë Kravitz
movies.plot: Matt Reeves' sequel to The Batman, currently in production. Plot details largely unconfirmed at time of writing.
movies.blurb: Matt Reeves' sequel to The Batman, currently filming.

movies.cast: Dwayne Johnson, Kevin Hart, Kate McKinnon, John Krasinski, Marc Maron, Keanu Reeves
movies.plot: Superman's loyal dog Krypto teams with a ragtag group of shelter pets who gain powers of their own, banding together to rescue the Justice League after they're captured by Lex Luthor and a vengeful guinea pig.
movies.blurb: Krypto and a shelter-pet squad get powers of their own in this CG animated comedy.

movies.cast: Horacio Garcia Rojas, Raymundo Armijo, Fernanda Robles
movies.plot: An Aztec-set reimagining following Yohualli Coatl, a young warrior avenging his father's death by donning a masked identity to fight conquistadors, released theatrically in Mexico.
movies.blurb: An Aztec-set reimagining of Batman, released theatrically in Mexico.

movies.cast: Kevin Conroy, Dana Delany, Hart Bochner, Mark Hamill
movies.plot: A feature extension of Batman: The Animated Series, in which Batman is framed for a string of mob killings actually committed by a masked vigilante tied to his own past.
movies.blurb: A feature film extension of Batman: The Animated Series, considered one of the best Batman films in any medium.

movies.cast: Will Arnett, Michael Cera, Rosario Dawson, Zach Galifianakis, Ralph Fiennes
movies.plot: A comedic spin-off of The Lego Movie in which an emotionally stunted, glory-obsessed Batman must learn to work with others — including an accidentally-adopted Robin — after the Joker orchestrates his most personal scheme yet.
movies.blurb: A comedic spin-off of The Lego Movie, sending up decades of Batman media.

movies.cast: Greg Cipes, Scott Menville, Khary Payton, Tara Strong, Hynden Walch, Will Arnett
movies.plot: Jealous that every other hero has their own movie, the chibi Teen Titans set out to get one of their own, running afoul of a supervillain plot and a wickedly meta send-up of the superhero movie genre along the way.
movies.t: Teen Titans Go! To the Movies
movies.blurb: The chibi Teen Titans satirize the superhero movie genre itself.

movies.cast: Kevin Conroy, Michael Ansara, Loren Lester, Mary Kay Bergman
movies.plot: Batman and Robin race to save Barbara Gordon after Mr. Freeze kidnaps her, needing a blood transfusion to save his cryogenically-frozen wife's life.
movies.blurb: Batman and Robin race to save Barbara Gordon after Mr. Freeze kidnaps her for a transfusion.

movies.cast: Will Friedle, Kevin Conroy, Mark Hamill
movies.plot: An older Bruce Wayne and his successor Terry McGinnis confront a resurrected Joker, whose return unearths a dark secret from Bruce's past with the original Robin, Tim Drake.
movies.t: Batman Beyond: Return of the Joker
movies.blurb: An older Bruce Wayne and successor Terry McGinnis confront a resurrected Joker.

movies.cast: Kevin Conroy, Kyra Sedgwick, Elisa Gabrielli, Kevin Michael Richardson
movies.plot: A mysterious new Batwoman appears in Gotham, forcing Batman to determine whether she's an ally or a dangerous vigilante — and to uncover which of three women is hiding behind the mask.
movies.blurb: A mysterious new Batwoman appears in Gotham, and Batman must uncover her identity.

movies.cast: Rino Romano, Peter Stormare, Alimi Ballard
movies.plot: Set in The Batman's animated continuity, the Penguin's grave-robbing scheme accidentally resurrects Count Dracula, forcing Batman to become a vampire hunter.
movies.blurb: Set in The Batman TV series' universe, Dracula rises in Gotham after the Penguin unearths his coffin.

movies.cast: George Newbern, Dana Delany, Powers Boothe, Christina Ricci
movies.plot: Loosely connected to Superman: The Animated Series but not considered official DCAU canon, pitting Superman and Lex Luthor against an invading Brainiac.
movies.blurb: Loosely connected to Superman: The Animated Series but not considered official DCAU continuity.

movies.director: Lauren Montgomery, Brandon Vietti, Bruce Timm
movies.cast: Adam Baldwin, Anne Heche, James Marsters
movies.plot: An animated adaptation of the Death of Superman storyline, as the unstoppable creature Doomsday rampages toward Metropolis and Superman gives everything to stop it.
movies.blurb: Adapts the Death of Superman storyline; opens the long-running DC Universe Animated Original Movies line.

movies.cast: Kyle MacLachlan, Jeremy Sisto, Lucy Lawless, Miguel Ferrer
movies.plot: Based on Darwyn Cooke's DC: The New Frontier, tracking a new generation of heroes emerging against a Cold War backdrop and uniting against a mysterious, world-threatening force.
movies.blurb: Based on Darwyn Cooke's DC: The New Frontier, set against the backdrop of the Cold War.

movies.cast: Kevin Conroy
movies.plot: Six anime-style animated shorts by different directors, bridging the gap between Batman Begins and The Dark Knight as Bruce Wayne refines his approach to crimefighting.
movies.blurb: Six anime-style shorts bridging Batman Begins and The Dark Knight.

movies.cast: Keri Russell, Nathan Fillion, Alfred Molina, Rosario Dawson
movies.plot: An origin story loosely based on 'Gods and Mortals,' pitting a young Diana against the god of war Ares after a downed pilot crash-lands on Themyscira.
movies.blurb: An origin story pitting Diana against Ares, loosely based on 'Gods and Mortals'.

movies.cast: Christopher Meloni, Victor Garber, Michael Madsen
movies.plot: Test pilot Hal Jordan's induction into the Green Lantern Corps, uncovering a conspiracy of corruption within the ranks of his new intergalactic peacekeeping force.
movies.blurb: A standalone adaptation of Hal Jordan's induction into the Green Lantern Corps.

movies.cast: Tim Daly, Kevin Conroy, Clancy Brown, Allison Mack
movies.plot: With the U.S. President framing Superman for murder and a kryptonite meteor bearing down on Earth, Batman and Superman go on the run together as fugitives.
movies.blurb: With the U.S. President framing Superman for murder, Batman and Superman team up on the run.

movies.cast: James Woods, Mark Harmon, Chris Noth, Gina Torres
movies.plot: A parallel-Earth Justice League of evildoers, the Crime Syndicate, threatens to invade the heroes' world after overthrowing their own.
movies.t: Justice League: Crisis on Two Earths
movies.blurb: A parallel-Earth Justice League of evildoers threatens to invade the heroes' world.

movies.cast: Bruce Greenwood, Jensen Ackles, John DiMaggio, Neil Patrick Harris
movies.plot: A resurrected Jason Todd returns to Gotham as the lethal vigilante Red Hood, challenging Batman's no-kill code and demanding he finally deal with the Joker.
movies.blurb: A resurrected Jason Todd returns as a lethal vigilante challenging Batman's no-kill rule.

movies.cast: Tim Daly, Kevin Conroy, Summer Glau, Andre Braugher
movies.plot: Supergirl's arrival on Earth draws the attention of Darkseid and Apokolips, forcing Superman and Batman to protect her from being conscripted into Darkseid's army.
movies.blurb: Supergirl's arrival on Earth draws the attention of Darkseid and Apokolips.

movies.cast: James Denton, Christina Hendricks, Anthony LaPaglia, Ed Asner
movies.plot: A faithful adaptation of the acclaimed Morrison/Quitely comic, sending a dying Superman through twelve labors to secure his legacy before his powers fail him for good.
movies.blurb: A faithful adaptation of the acclaimed Morrison/Quitely comic, sending a dying Superman through twelve labors.

movies.cast: Nathan Fillion, Elisabeth Moss, Henry Rollins
movies.plot: An anthology of Green Lantern Corps tales, framed by Hal Jordan learning the history of the ring he now wears from past and present Lanterns.
movies.blurb: An anthology of Green Lantern Corps tales framed by Hal Jordan's training.

movies.cast: Ben McKenzie, Bryan Cranston, Eliza Dushku, Jon Polito
movies.plot: A faithful adaptation of Frank Miller and David Mazzucchelli's foundational origin story, following Bruce Wayne's first year as Batman alongside Jim Gordon's arrival in a corrupt Gotham.
movies.blurb: A faithful adaptation of Frank Miller and David Mazzucchelli's foundational origin story.

movies.cast: Justin Chambers, Kevin Conroy, C. Thomas Howell, Michael B. Jordan, Cary Elwes, Nathan Fillion, Vanessa Marshall, Dana Delany
movies.plot: The Flash wakes in a fractured alternate timeline where his mother lives, his powers are gone, and a war between the Amazons and Atlanteans is destroying the world — forcing him to find a grittier, unfamiliar Batman to help restore reality.
movies.blurb: DCAMU film 1 — Barry Allen wakes in an altered timeline after trying to prevent his mother's death.

movies.cast: Jason O'Mara, Sean Astin, Shemar Moore, Christopher Gorham, Alan Tudyk, Justin Kirk, Michelle Monaghan
movies.plot: A New 52-inspired retelling of the Justice League's first battle, as Batman, Green Lantern, Superman, Wonder Woman, Flash, and Cyborg unite for the first time to stop an invasion by Darkseid's forces.
movies.blurb: DCAMU film 2 — a New 52-inspired retelling of the League's first battle against Darkseid.

movies.cast: Jason O'Mara, Stuart Allan, Thomas Gibson, Sean Maher, Morena Baccarin
movies.plot: Batman discovers he has a son, Damian Wayne, secretly raised as a killer by the League of Assassins — and must train the violent, unruly boy while facing Damian's grandfather, Ra's al Ghul, and the mercenary Deathstroke.
movies.blurb: DCAMU film 3 — Batman discovers and trains his son, Damian Wayne.

movies.cast: Kevin Conroy, C.C.H. Pounder, Neal McDonough, Hynden Walch, Troy Baker
movies.plot: Set in the Batman: Arkham video game continuity, the Suicide Squad is sent to infiltrate Arkham Asylum and steal sensitive data from the Riddler — only to stumble into a bomb plot that draws Batman himself into the mix.
movies.blurb: Set in the Batman: Arkham video game universe, the Suicide Squad infiltrates Arkham Asylum.

movies.cast: Jason O'Mara, Matt Lanter, Shemar Moore, Rosario Dawson, Jerry O'Connell, Sam Witwer

comics.ord: The first appearance of Superman — the start of the entire superhero genre.
comics.blurb: Superman's debut, and the birth of the superhero comic as a form.

comics.ord: Batman's first appearance, a full year before he gets an origin story.
comics.blurb: Batman's debut as a mysterious vigilante, predating Robin, the Batcave, and even a clear origin.

comics.ord: Introduces Diana before her own solo title begins the following year.
comics.blurb: Wonder Woman's first appearance, created by William Moulton Marston.

comics.ord: The formation of the Justice Society of America, the genre's first superhero team.
comics.blurb: DC's earliest heroes — Flash, Green Lantern, Hawkman, and others — unite as the JSA.

comics.ord: Introduces Barry Allen, generally considered the start of the Silver Age.
comics.blurb: Barry Allen becomes the second Flash, kicking off DC's Silver Age revival of its heroes.

comics.ord: Introduces the multiverse concept, setting up every future Crisis event.
comics.blurb: Barry Allen meets Golden Age Flash Jay Garrick, establishing that DC's eras coexist on parallel Earths.

comics.ord: Introduces Hal Jordan as the new Green Lantern.
comics.blurb: Test pilot Hal Jordan is chosen by a dying alien to wield the power ring.

comics.ord: The formation of the modern Justice League.
comics.blurb: Superman, Batman, Flash, Green Lantern, Wonder Woman, and Aquaman unite for the first time as the JLA.

comics.ord: A socially conscious run pairing Hal Jordan's idealism against Oliver Queen's activism.
comics.blurb: Denny O'Neil and Neal Adams tackle drug addiction, racism, and poverty through a superhero lens.

comics.ord: Introduces the New Gods and Darkseid into the DC Universe.
comics.blurb: Jack Kirby's cosmic Fourth World mythology begins here, in an unlikely Jimmy Olsen title.

comics.ord: A key story re-establishing Joker as a genuinely lethal threat after the campy '60s tone.
comics.blurb: Steve Englehart and Marshall Rogers redefine the Joker as a dangerous, elegant menace.

comics.ord: Collapses the multiverse into one timeline — the hard dividing line between Pre- and Post-Crisis continuity.
comics.blurb: DC's original universe-spanning event, erasing decades of divergent continuity into a single Earth.

comics.ord: The definitive post-Crisis origin; read first for any modern Batman reading order.
comics.blurb: Frank Miller and David Mazzucchelli retell Bruce Wayne's first year as Batman, alongside Jim Gordon's arrival in Gotham.

comics.ord: John Byrne's post-Crisis reboot of Superman's origin and powers.
comics.blurb: Streamlines Superman's mythology and powers, resetting the character for the modern era.

comics.ord: Not in main continuity — a possible future in which an aged Bruce Wayne returns to the cowl.
comics.blurb: Frank Miller's dystopian future vision reshaped how mainstream comics portrayed Batman for decades.

comics.ord: Self-contained; not part of core DCU continuity (later pulled in via Doomsday Clock).
comics.blurb: Alan Moore and Dave Gibbons deconstruct the superhero genre through a murder mystery among retired vigilantes.

comics.ord: Generally treated as in-continuity; establishes the modern Joker/Batman dynamic and Barbara Gordon's paralysis.
comics.blurb: Alan Moore and Brian Bolland probe the thin line between Batman's sanity and the Joker's madness.

comics.blurb: Neil Gaiman's saga of Dream and the other Endless, blending myth, horror, and literary fantasy.

comics.ord: Self-contained; not connected to DCU continuity.

comics.ord: Spun off from Swamp Thing; the flagship of the Vertigo occult-detective line.

comics.ord: DCU-adjacent horror run that effectively seeded what would become the Vertigo imprint.

comics.ord: Followed by Funeral for a Friend, then Reign of the Supermen.

comics.ord: A possible future where an older generation of heroes clashes with an unchecked new one.

comics.ord: Standalone; not connected to main continuity.
